subject: general
question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 76, 28, 79, 17, 33, 95, 83, 30 and 27 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume a **deviation base** of 50 for the given observations.

Net Deviation = 26 − 22 + 29 − 33 − 17 + 45 + 33 − 20 − 23 = +18

Average = Base + (Net Deviation ÷ Total observations) = 50 + (18 ÷ 9) = 50 + 2 = 52

**∴ The correct answer is 52.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Observations = 76, 28, 79, 17, 33, 95, 83, 30, 27

**Formula Used:** Arithmetic Mean = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34da6391e3424f9f6a2c59414f6a62693ce7348eb6b0a969b3860cb9756396d4.png] 

⇒ Sum = 76 + 28 + 79 + 17 + 33 + 95 + 83 + 30 + 27

⇒ Sum = 468

⇒ Total count (n) = 9

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 468 ÷ 9

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 52

**∴ The correct answer is 52.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Arithmetic Mean

The sum of **deviations** of a set of observations from their arithmetic mean is always zero. Σ(xᵢ − x̄) = 0.

Combined Mean

If two groups have means x̄₁ and x̄₂ with sizes n₁ and n₂, the **combined mean** is (n₁x̄₁ + n₂x̄₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Weighted Mean

Used when observations have different **importance** or weights: Mean = Σ(wᵢxᵢ) ÷ Σwᵢ.</p
